title: "Tripping" Animated Digital Artwork
subtitle: Combining constructionism, surrealism, and brutalism in a generative oil painting
seo_title: Tripping Animated Digital Art — Surrealist AI Motion Artwork
seo_description: An animated generative art piece blending constructionist structures with surrealist and brutalist elements in an oil-painting style.
thumb_alt: Animated generative artwork showing surreal brutalist structures with oil painting textures
img_alt: Still frames from the animated surrealist digital artwork
challenge: Creating compelling, dream-like motion within a static, highly textured, AI-generated image without breaking the illusion of a painted physical medium.
approach: Starting with a highly detailed, brutalist-surrealist generative base image, motion layers and depth maps were carefully constructed to isolate environmental elements, enabling slow, hypnotic animation that respects the original 'painted' texture.
result: An evocative, looping digital artwork that pulls the viewer into a surreal, constructed landscape, proving that generative static art can successfully cross over into engaging motion media.
